units: Linear RGB in the room observer convention. Each reference path starts on a uniformly area-sampled receiver region. Its emitter intensity and final material use the same convention as display.
contactMeasurement: 64 × 64 deterministic integration of the represented field across the stated receiver region. Independent physical references from projected-line-room.json. The four handoff poses instead integrate the represented bilinear field exactly over the observation rectangle.
singlePoseTiming: Single diagnostic poses, tick 30, including GPU readback. No compositor measurement or distribution is implied.

independentFinalTransfer.description: The independent tracer launches a cosine direction from a uniform point on the finite receiver. At its first geometry hit it evaluates the represented indirect function in native chart coordinates, adds independently visible lamp light, and multiplies the source and receiver materials. No previous solver coefficients enter the check. Each mean includes escaped paths as zero; uncertainties are one standard error.

parallelOverlapTrialDescription: Exploratory fresh solves in the same architecture. Clip projected UV bounds to the receiving domain before placing gap-scale breaks. Baseline cutover does not enable this trial.
replayMeasurement: Frozen cutover d4d789b. On this M1 Pro the existing 120 consecutive moving poses render at 3840 × 2160. GPU-complete is a synchronous readback; swap is the matching Chrome compositor marker. The complete interval ends at the later of these two times. Camera visibility overlaps preparation. Counted memory includes named engine payloads and one framebuffer, excludes uninstrumented JavaScript, driver and compositor allocations. Short independent QA jobs overlapped portions of the one- and two-slat runs. No matched-quality speedup is established.

scanlineMotionCheck.samples: Across 21 nearby fresh angles, take run endpoints, exterior neighbors and midpoints on every 47th scanline starting at row 19. Use the union of pixels in every pose. Compare against independent nearest intersection and lamp-segment visibility; count temporal changes of visible surface and illuminated state. Only this sampled sweep is verified.

energyAuditDescription: Emit unit exitance on one side at a time and integrate the common receiver measure over the complete room. A ratio above unity exceeds all power the isolated surface sends. Whole-room colored totals are reported separately.
residualWitnessConvention: True denotes direct numerical evaluation of the settled source integral at the observation, not an independent path-traced ground truth. Compare with the reconstructed field, then multiply by receiver reflectance. Witnesses obtained by contracting the same weak operator in a different summation order.
